title: zernike.native spec
description: What a zernike.native request asks for: of each field, an engine's wavefront at one line referred to the sphere about the chief ray's landing (OpticStudio's reference to the chief ray), sampled at the midpoints of a square grid strictly inside the unit circle of normalised pupil coordinates, its RMS and peak to valley in waves, and its least-squares Zernike coefficients in waves by the ordering asked. Code checks that the grid is even and that a Fringe fit asks at most 37 terms.

line.description: The line, an index in conditions.lines.

fieldAnglesDeg.description: The field angles in object space, degrees, in the order the answer lists them. A positive angle is an object toward +y.

grid.description: The number of cells across the square of normalised pupil coordinates [-1, 1]: the samples are the midpoints (2 k + 1) / grid - 1 strictly inside the unit circle, as wavefront.native's.

ordering.description: standard: OpticStudio's Zernike Standard polynomials, Noll's sequential index from 1, each of unit RMS over the unit disc. fringe: OpticStudio's Zernike Fringe polynomials, the University of Arizona index from 1, unnormalised.

terms.description: How many polynomials the fit takes, from the first of the ordering.
